leagueLeadersFold.rule: Beckett lists a multi-player card (this product's League Leaders-style subset) as several CONSECUTIVE rows under the SAME card number, one per player, never one row with the roster already joined. convertBeckettChecklistXlsx.cjs now merges consecutive same-numbered rows within one section into a single row, players joined '/' in source order -- reproducing the repo's OWN existing convention for a multi-player card (measured on committed CSVs: `base,152,,false,,Alan Benes/Andy Benes` in 1996-sp-baseball.csv; `insert-league-leaders,1,,false,,Mike Bossy/Marcel Dionne/Guy Lafleur` in 1979-80-o-pee-chee-hockey.csv), not a new shape. The merge requires ADJACENCY -- the immediately preceding record in the same section -- so a genuine same-numbered DIFFERENT-card defect elsewhere in a section still refuses rather than silently merging.
leagueLeadersFold.measured: 10 card numbers (11, 38, 84, 117, 130, 151, 203, 204, 211, 327), 3 players each, appearing on both the plain Base Set run and its Golden Mirror Variation parallel (the one rung sharing the Base sheet's own layout) -- 60 raw rows collapsed to 20, dropping the file's row count by 40 (2,943 -> 2,903).
leagueLeadersFold.example: cardNumber 11: Pete Alonso/Kyle Schwarber/Juan Soto (both the plain row and the Golden Mirror Variation row).

rookieCardFlag.rule: Beckett's xlsx appends an ' RC' rookie-card flag to the player field on the sheets that carry it (the Base sheet, and the Golden Mirror Variation section which lives on a sheet with the same column layout) -- never on the sheets for the other 8 stated parallel rungs or the 7 originally-own-cards sections. The checklist-csv-contract has no rookie/RC column, so a new one was NOT invented. The ' RC' suffix is stripped from every `player` cell in this CSV instead (PER PLAYER on a merged multi-player row, not just the tail of the whole field), and the fact is preserved here as a card-level list rather than a per-row column, since RC is a property of the CARD, not of one parallel's spelling of it.
rookieCardFlag.whyItMatters: cleanPlayerName (backend/src/services/portfolioiq/cardCatalog.service.ts) has no RC handling -- confirmed by running it directly: cleanPlayerName('Jonah Tong RC') returns 'Jonah Tong RC' unchanged, and playerSlugify() on that mints `jonah-tong-rc` while every other row for the same player (all 8 other parallels of card #4, every sale, every other product) mints `jonah-tong`. Left unstripped, base rows would never match on playerSlug against their own parallels or against sales for the same card.
rookieCardFlag.measured: 142 rows carried the suffix pre-strip: 71 plain-base rows (category=base, blank parallel) + 71 Golden Mirror Variation rows (the one parallel rung that shares the Base sheet's column layout) -- the same 71 distinct cardNumbers in both groups, 0 exceptions. Every other stated parallel and every one of the 7 roster-folded sections below already read the plain name with no RC suffix anywhere.

r67RosterFold.rule: convertBeckettChecklistXlsx.cjs's classifySections gained a permanent second pass (added in the same round as the League Leaders/RC fixes): a section whose (cardNumber -> player) map, after RC-suffix strip and R67 normalisation, equals or is a subset of the file's actual flagship run (PLAIN_SECTION, never merely category='base') on every shared number with zero disagreements folds onto it with the section's own header as the parallel. This is now the CONVERTER's own behaviour, not a hand relabel.
